faqs.q: What forms of identification does SunnyDayz accept

a.text: SunnyDayz accepts Valid state-issued driver’s license, U.S. passport/passport card, military ID, permanent resident card, or foreign passport.
a.html: SunnyDayz accepts Valid state-issued driver’s license, U.S. passport/passport card, military ID, permanent resident card, or foreign passport.

a.text: SunnyDayz does not accept the following forms of Identification: Expired Drivers License, photocopies or photos of Driver’s License, temporary paper licenses without required supporting documentation, student IDs, employer IDs, library cards, or similar IDs.
